identity_description: Very fair pale-peach skin. A small, pronounced face: elongated forehead above the brows, compact oval, fuller soft cheeks, slender V-shaped jawline, and short rounded chin. High slim nose bridge, small rounded tip, and small lips with a fuller lower lip. Symmetric long slender eyes with gently upturned outer corners, moderately narrow eyelid openings, centered pupils, and natural facial proportion; both eyes have chestnut-brown and orange-amber irises; both irises are equal in size and proportion, and both pupils are equal in size and proportion. Deep petrol-teal, extremely voluminous jaw-length bob with medium-density hair. A deep viewer-right side part and full short fringe sweep across the viewer-left forehead, ending above the eyebrow. Large loose S-waves, pronounced inward C-curls, and tapered side locks create an expansive rounded silhouette.
rear_hair_identity: Deep petrol-teal, extremely voluminous jaw-length bob with medium-density hair; preserve the rear bob silhouette, nape hairline, and hair color.
